style.backgroundSystem: soft blush gradient studio walls with cylindrical podium accents, alternating with clean #FFFFFF card panels and light grey #F2F2F2 info screens
style.iconSystem: thin-line icons inside soft gradient circles from #F6C9D2 to #E8899E
style.lightingSystem: bright soft front-top studio key with gentle fill, low-contrast soft shadows, warm cozy mood; lifestyle shots use natural window light
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent gentle laundry-care ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of soft blush #F6C9D2 backgrounds, clean #FFFFFF panels, deep charcoal #2D2D2D text, and one rose-red #D4406A accent for pill labels and highlights; warm tone; modern geometric sans-serif headlines with small rounded pill labels; consistent thin-line icons inside soft gradient circles from #F6C9D2 to #E8899E; bright soft front-top studio key with gentle fill and low-contrast soft shadows; stable upright product placement with consistent scale; balanced breathing margins in every layout; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: bottle upright and centered, stable slight 3/4 or straight-on angle, consistent product scale across the set
style.surfaceSystem: matte rose podium, light wood surfaces and soft cotton textiles in lifestyle scenes
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, bold charcoal headlines with small rounded pill labels in the accent color
